title: Trump Threatens to Withdraw US Troops from Italy and Spain Over Iran War Reluctance
detail: President Trump threatened to withdraw US troops stationed in Italy and Spain as the rift between the United States and European allies deepened over their reluctance to back Washington's Iran war strategy. The threat marks a significant escalation in the transatlantic dispute, with Trump leveraging the US military footprint in Southern Europe as a pressure tool against allies unwilling to align with his Iran policy.
